description:
As an advisor, I want to see when prices were last updated so that I know how fresh the values are.
Given prices were updated today, when I open the portfolio, then I see "Prices as of <time>" under the total
Given prices are older than one day, then the note says "Prices may be out of date"
traps: no 'Acceptance criteria' heading: the parser must fall back to Given/When/Then lines
